jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY / United States · Hybrid or Remote

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager

It uses Kevin’s marketing background as a supporting foundation while keeping the core work systems- and operations-focused rather than SEO-focused.

jobs.title: Healthcare Technical Operations Manager

jobs.gap: This is technically deeper than Kevin’s current background and includes production support for health-plan core administrative systems, claims/adjudication and tools such as Jira/ServiceNow. Treat it as a reach and do not imply direct claims-platform expertise.
